newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST-Bank/Portugal seen not changing rates.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Bank/Portugal seen not changing rates.

text.p: Nine out of 10 analysts polled by Reuters on Wednesday did not expect the Bank of Portugal to reduce its repurchase pact rate on Thursday when it sets conditions for the next commercial bank reserve period.
None of the 10 predicted a cut in the drain, or absorption rate, which is the level at which the Bank absorbs excess market funds. The drain rate stands at 5.80 percent.
The only analyst who forecast a cut in the repo, predicted that the Bank would shave 20 basis points from the rate which currently stands at 6.30 percent.

Analysts cited the recent easing of the escudo against the mark as the main reason why the Bank would wait before cutting rates further. However, all the analysts polled said that there was room, technically, for rate cuts.
The Bank last cut its official rates on April 11 when it took 20 basis points off the repo and 40 off the drain rate.

The following banks and brokerages took part in the poll and were prepared to be identified: Banco Finantia, Banco Portugues de Investimento, Banco Mello de Investimentos, Banco de Comercio & Industria, Credit Lyonnais, IMF-Informacao de Mercados Financeiros, Siemca-Sociedade Mediadora de Capitais, Fincor, Banco Essi.
